reading_method: All pypdf pages of each companion displayed and read in full. This records semantic review; it is not standalone financial acceptance. Independent reader/primary bindings and original-page issue inspection are separate.

Same-event conversion-price adjustment citing implementation 2024-098. Current interim cash 0.25; suspension dates concern conversion of bond 113682.
Same-event conversion-price adjustment citing primary 2024-079. Current cash RMB 2.5 per ten shares differs from diluted reference 0.2487. Earlier 2021–2024 price history is separate.
Same-event first-three-quarter conversion-price adjustment. Cash RMB 0.3 per ten shares; previous annual/interim distributions are explicitly historical.
Same-event conversion-price adjustment across calendar year. RMB 1 gross per ten shares versus diluted reference0.0988; generic conditional anti-dilution clauses do not revise the current payment.

Full text confirms current half-year dividend and convertible effective date; historical 0.48 and 0.38193 cash terms concern prior years. Conversion stop dates are not an explicitly labelled stock record date or stock suspension.

10.60 yuan per ten ordinary shares; preferred-share codes in the heading are not the recipient identity for these A-share terms.
